raw.details:
Overview:

Innovate with AI. Solve for Society. Build for Impact.

Sociathon 2026, in collaboration with the Social Welfare and Development Committee, VIT Pune, is a flagship innovation initiative that brings together young innovators, developers, designers, and problem-solvers to leverage Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies to address real-world social challenges.

Aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), Sociathon 2026 provides participants with a platform to transform ideas into impactful solutions across domains such as Healthcare, Sustainability, Education, and the Future of Work.

Participants will get an opportunity to explore and apply cutting-edge technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Granite LLM, and other emerging tools while collaborating in interdisciplinary teams.

Hackathon Journey:

Round 1 — Online | Idea Submission:  FREE

Participants will submit their innovative solution idea through a PPT, following the prescribed template and aligned with the hackathon themes.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Innovation
  • Feasibility
  • Alignment with SDGs

Eligibility Requirement:

All team members must complete the designated free Guided Learning Experience (GLE) and submit the corresponding badge/certificate.
This is what GLE look like:

https://skills.yourlearning.ibm.com/activity/PLAN-FA448E08E2A9?ngo-id=0331&utm_campaign=aca-1M1B-hackathon

Round 2 — Online | Idea Pitching: Rupees 500 per team

Shortlisted teams from Round 1 will make payment of rupees 500 and will present & pitch their ideas virtually before a panel of judges.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Clarity of the solution
  • Feasibility
  • Presentation skills
  • Q&A handling

Round 3 — On-Campus | Prototype & Final Pitch:

The finalists will move to the on-campus finale, where they will transform their ideas into working prototypes and present their solutions before an expert jury.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Working prototype
  • Innovation
  • Social impact
  • Presentation

Themes:

Participants can build solutions addressing challenges in areas such as:

  • Healthcare
  • Sustainability & Environment
  • Education
  • Future of Work
  • Other Social Impact Challenges aligned with the SDGs

Team Formation:

  • Team size: 1–4 members
  • Interdisciplinary teams are encouraged.
  • Participants are encouraged to bring diverse skills across technology, design, research, and problem-solving.

Project Deliverables:

Teams will progress through three stages:

  • Round 1: PPT-based Idea Submission(Free)
  • Round 2: Online Idea Pitch(500 fees)
  • Round 3: Working Prototype + Final Pitch Presentation

Disqualification:

A team may be disqualified if:

  • The submission is copied, plagiarized, or lacks originality.
  • The team fails to follow submission guidelines or deadlines.
  • The team does not meet the prescribed team-size or eligibility requirements.
  • Participants engage in misconduct, academic dishonesty, or disruptive behaviour during the event.
  • If selected for 2nd round but not completed payment.

Why Participate?

Sociathon 2026 is an opportunity to go beyond simply building a project. Identify a meaningful problem, leverage emerging technology, collaborate with diverse minds, and build a solution that can create real-world impact.

Bring your ideas. Build with AI. Create for society.

Are you ready to build the future with purpose?
